AIIMG.Pick.Title: Choose a version
AIIMG.Pick.Hint: “Use this” sets the version as the document image.

AIIMG.Config.OutPrevSame: No change: the generated image ({size}) is not larger than this limit.

AIIMG.Enhance.Err.no-key: No Anthropic API key. Add it in the module settings.
AIIMG.Enhance.Err.empty-input: Type a short description first, e.g. "young superhero".
AIIMG.Enhance.Err.too-long: The description is too long to enhance (max {max} characters).
AIIMG.Enhance.Err.auth: Anthropic rejected the API key. Check it in the settings.
AIIMG.Enhance.Err.permission: This API key has no access to the selected model.
AIIMG.Enhance.Err.model: Model "{model}" does not exist. Fix the id in the settings.

AIIMG.Enhance.Err.overloaded: Anthropic is overloaded right now. Try again in a moment.
AIIMG.Enhance.Err.network: Could not reach Anthropic. Check your network and API key.
AIIMG.Enhance.Err.timeout: Claude did not answer in time. Try again.
AIIMG.Enhance.Err.refusal: Claude declined to rewrite this description. Change it and try again.
